title: 2021 TOPPS INCEPTION KEIBERT RUIZ ROOKIE CARD LOS ANGELES DODGERS BASEBALL MLB
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2021 Topps Inception baseball trading card featuring Keibert Ruiz, a rookie player for the Los Angeles Dodgers. The card is part of the TOPPS INCEPTION series and has the card number #33. It is an original card manufactured by Topps, and is not autographed. 

The card is a single product and belongs to the category of sports trading cards. It is suitable for collectors and fans of the Major League baseball. The card attributes include the theme of sport, the era of modern baseball (1981-now), and the original/reprint status. The product is an original and comes from the 2021 season.
